findings.summary: The Fish script can't parse the new three-line-per-item completion format: Fish splits the output on newlines, so the loop runs once per line rather than per item, and all completions are lost.
format_completion escapes newlines in value and help text, but the Fish script never unescapes them, so users see literal \n in descriptions and values containing newlines are corrupted.
The `.. versionchanged:: 8.3` note in the docstring doesn't match the changelog, which lists the fix as Unreleased after 8.3.3, so it should say 8.4.
